Background & experience

Human geography · Chinese Academy of Sciences

I am a postdoctoral researcher in human geography at the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences, working with Prof. Chuanglin Fang. I received my Ph.D. in Human Geography from the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2025, and my bachelor's degree in Human Geography and Urban–Rural Planning from Sun Yat-sen University in 2020.
